lanes.title: External world
lanes.description: Things outside the watch: the Gadgetbridge phone, internet APIs, the host PC and its Python tools, and the NTP server.

lanes.title: Hardware
lanes.description: Physical parts of the 1.43-B: AMOLED panel, touch, IMU, RTC, SD card, battery ADC, BOOT button, radio, and the optional strap modules (unverified on this board).

lanes.title: Drivers and HAL
lanes.description: Device layer in firmware/main: board.c, hal_esp32.c, hal_store, SD lease, display flush, battery sampler, BLE/Wi-Fi/USB links and the strap drivers.

lanes.title: Tasks and timers
lanes.description: Every FreeRTOS task and timer with its core, priority and cadence. Each one also appears in the schedule table.

lanes.title: Engine and rendering
lanes.description: UI engine in nos/: frame run, screen stack, input, power states, DFS, damage-diffed stripe renderer, layer cache, blur stack, dot/arc/font helpers.

lanes.title: Services and domain logic
lanes.description: Service layer ticked by svc_tick plus domain engines: activity, pedometer, heart, alarms, Gadgetbridge, sports/workout, power policy, prefs, diagnostics, transfer.

lanes.title: Stores and persistence
lanes.description: Every place data lives: NVS keys, SD files, RTC chip, retained RTC RAM, flash blobs, PSRAM/DRAM caches and RAM-only state.

lanes.title: Apps and system screens
lanes.description: Launcher apps and system screens (boot, home pager, control center, notifications, power, settings pages, ring screens).

lanes.title: Watch faces
lanes.description: The nine home watch faces and the shared face registry and kit that the Home pager dispatches to.

nodes.label: Phone (Gadgetbridge)
nodes.summary: Android phone running Gadgetbridge (Bangle.js protocol) over BLE Nordic UART. Pushes notifications, calls, music, weather, find, alarms, time; receives battery, steps, HR and control lines.
nodes.runs: Off-watch. Lines drained by the watch at up to 8 per services tick.

nodes.label: Open-Meteo API
nodes.summary: Public forecast HTTP API used by the watch's own Wi-Fi weather fetch (current, hourly, daily). Needs Wi-Fi, a stored lat/lon and a valid clock.
nodes.runs: Off-watch. Queried every 1800 s (60 s after a failure) by the weather task.

nodes.label: LLM / STT / TTS API
nodes.summary: OpenRouter-style cloud API used by voice chat on the 1.43C board. On the 1.43-B voice_chat is compiled as stubs, so this path is never used.
nodes.runs: Off-watch. Not reachable on the B build.

nodes.label: Host PC (serial, OTA, setup browser)
nodes.summary: PC on USB serial or the watch's Wi-Fi: sends text commands, uploads firmware (/ota, /ota_url), opens the setup page and can POST /notify to the companion bridge.
nodes.runs: Off-watch. Event driven by the user.
nodes.note: Followup 5 - USB command to handler map and host protocol edge cases

nodes.label: Host tools (flash_watch, sdsync, exports)
nodes.summary: Python tools: checked flash helper (preserves NVS), SD sync over SDXFER, diag/sports/IMU/workout export and power analysis. They pull files the watch wrote to SD.
nodes.runs: Off-watch. Run by the developer on demand.
nodes.note: Followup 5 - USB command to handler map and host protocol edge cases

nodes.label: SNTP time server
nodes.summary: Internet time source. Once Wi-Fi is up the watch runs SNTP in poll mode and sets the system clock; the RTC chip is then written back by board-fs.
nodes.runs: Off-watch. Re-synced about hourly while Wi-Fi is connected.
nodes.note: Followup 1 - Time source, RTC trust and midnight rollover end to end

nodes.label: AMOLED panel 466x466 (CO5300 profile, QSPI)
nodes.summary: 466x466 RGB565 AMOLED on QSPI (CS9, CLK10, D0-D3 11-14, reset21, enable42) at 80 MHz. No TE line routed. Controller identity unconfirmed: the CO5300 init profile works, forcing SH8601 gave a black screen.
nodes.runs: Hardware. Driven by the flush task; DISPOFF/SLPIN in sleep states.

nodes.label: FT3168 touch (0x38)
nodes.summary: Capacitive touch on shared I2C (SDA47/SCL48). No interrupt or reset GPIO on this board, so it is polled. Native coordinates map to the rotated UI as (465-y, x).
nodes.runs: Hardware. Polled by the touch task: 10 ms when ON, 40 ms otherwise.

nodes.label: QMI8658 IMU (0x6B)
nodes.summary: 6-axis accelerometer/gyro, INT on GPIO8 (not used for TE). Configured at 500 Hz and never slowed. Source for steps, wrist-raise wake, knock detection, workout motion and IMU logs.
nodes.runs: Hardware. Read about 150 times/s by board-sense, with the screen on or off.

nodes.label: PCF85063 RTC (0x51)
nodes.summary: Battery-backed calendar chip on shared I2C. Provides UTC at boot after a trust check (OS bit and 12-hour bit rejected). Written back from the system clock by board-fs.
nodes.runs: Hardware. Read once at boot; written when board_clock_changed is set.
nodes.note: Followup 1 - Time source, RTC trust and midnight rollover end to end

nodes.label: SD card (1-bit SDMMC)
nodes.summary: SD on CLK41/CMD39/D0=40 (D3=38 unused). Holds authoritative settings banks, sports journals, workouts, IMU CSV, GPX, memos, diagnostics and orrery textures. B has an SD card; C does not.
nodes.runs: Hardware. Mounted by board-fs; every access goes through a mount lease and lock.

nodes.label: Battery ADC (GPIO4, divider 3)
nodes.summary: Measures the system rail on GPIO4 (ADC1 ch3, divider 3). There is no charge-status pin on B, so USB/charging is inferred from the rail voltage and percent is a model.
nodes.runs: Hardware. Sampled once a second by the battery sampler.

nodes.label: BOOT button (GPIO0)
nodes.summary: Side button on GPIO0. ISR with 25 ms debounce feeds click, double-click and long-press; also the only deep-sleep wake source (ext0, GPIO0 low).
nodes.runs: ISR on edge. Works in every display state.

nodes.label: Deep sleep (ext0 GPIO0 wake)
nodes.summary: Lowest power state, entered only by the POWER OFF action after the shutdown guard passes. All sampling stops; a BOOT press cold-boots the watch.
nodes.runs: Only on explicit POWER OFF.

nodes.label: ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi and BLE radio
nodes.summary: Shared 2.4 GHz radio. Wi-Fi station/AP and NimBLE are started by the radio admission controller only when heap allows; saved intent is reapplied every loop pass.
nodes.runs: Hardware. Powered per saved Wi-Fi/BLE intent.

nodes.label: Strap: MAX30102 HR/SpO2
nodes.summary: Optional back-header PPG module. Not verified on this B board; without it Heart rate, Breathe BPM and workout HR show nothing.
nodes.runs: Hardware. FIFO drained every 120 ms while leased; background read every 10 min.

nodes.label: Strap: GPS (UART)
nodes.summary: Optional GNSS strap on a UART. Probes three baud rates (about 12.6 s) when first enabled. Unverified on this board.
nodes.runs: Hardware. Powered only while a getter or owner keeps it alive (8 s idle).

nodes.label: Strap: Quectel EG800AK LTE
nodes.summary: Optional LTE modem strap (AT commands, SMS). Unverified; there is no call audio.
nodes.runs: Hardware. Modem off 8 s after the last UI caller.

nodes.label: Strap: BME280 baro/temp/humidity
nodes.summary: Optional environment sensor strap: pressure, temperature, humidity. Unverified on B.
nodes.runs: Hardware. Forced-mode read every 2 s once present.

nodes.label: Strap: APDS-9960 light/proximity
nodes.summary: Optional ambient-light and proximity strap. Unverified on B.
nodes.runs: Hardware. Read about every 400 ms by the ext task.

nodes.label: Strap: QMC5883L/HMC5883L compass
nodes.summary: Optional magnetometer strap for the Compass app. Needs a figure-8 calibration. Unverified on B.
nodes.runs: Hardware. Sampled only while a consumer asks.

nodes.label: Strap: coin ERM haptic motor
nodes.summary: Optional vibration motor strap driven by PWM patterns. B itself has no haptic motor.
nodes.runs: Hardware. Pattern segments timed by the haptic esp_timer.

nodes.label: Strap: MAX98357A amp + INMP441 mic
nodes.summary: Optional I2S speaker and microphone strap for Recorder and sounds. B has no built-in audio; C's codec path does not apply here.
nodes.runs: Hardware. I2S pumped in 4 ms blocks while recording or playing.

nodes.label: Board device layer (board.c)
nodes.summary: Owns I2C devices and creates the board-sense and board-fs tasks: IMU/touch reads, pedometer and calendar gate, SD mount, RTC trust, CSV log, sleep-park handshake.
nodes.runs: Library code called from board-sense, board-fs and the UI loop.

nodes.label: HAL glue (hal_esp32.c)
nodes.summary: Implements the core/hal.h contract on ESP-IDF: clock/timezone, hal_store, battery sampler, BLE/NUS, Wi-Fi and HTTP, asset reads, radio admission.
nodes.runs: Library code called from every task.

nodes.label: hal_store (NVS + SD routing)
nodes.summary: Blob API over NVS namespace 'wos'. Only nosprefs and wifi_cred are routed SD-first to checksummed banks; every other key is NVS only. save_checked verifies the write.
nodes.runs: Called inline by the owner of each key (UI task or board-fs).

nodes.label: SD mount, lease and lock
nodes.summary: Mounts the card and hands out a mount lease and SD lock so settings, journals, logs and transfers never mutate the card concurrently. Retry on request; no silent format.
nodes.runs: board-fs retries a failed mount; leases taken per file operation.

nodes.label: Display flush and QSPI panel driver
nodes.summary: Stripe job queue to the flush task, JOB_FENCE for stripe reuse, DMA-done credit, brightness and DISPOFF/SLPIN/SLPOUT/DISPON. Rotates native output CCW in software.
nodes.runs: Jobs queued by the UI task; executed on the flush task (core 1).

nodes.label: Display TE wait (no TE on B)
nodes.summary: Tearing-effect synchronisation helper. B does not route TE (GPIO8 is the IMU interrupt), so the Developer tools TE toggle has no effect on this board.
nodes.runs: Never active on B.

nodes.label: Battery sampler and percent model
nodes.summary: 8 ADC reads per second, median, EMA 1/5, percent model with a bat_cal offset. battery_valid needs 10 stable seconds on battery. USB/charging is inferred from voltage; no charge pin.
nodes.runs: Triggered at 1 Hz from board-sense, screen on or off.

nodes.label: RTC trust and write-back
nodes.summary: board_restore_clock reads the PCF85063 at boot; rtc_maintain writes the system time back as BCD when board_clock_changed is set and on shutdown.
nodes.runs: Boot once; rtc_maintain on every board-fs pass (100 ms), forced at shutdown.
nodes.note: Followup 1 - Time source, RTC trust and midnight rollover end to end

nodes.label: BLE host, advertising, GATT and bonding
nodes.summary: NimBLE stack: advertising, connection parameters, reconnect, bonding, scan lease, companion 0xF2 frames and the XFR transfer service. Radio admission decides when it may start.
nodes.runs: NimBLE host task plus the 100 ms ble_control_tick callout.
nodes.note: Followup 6 - Gadgetbridge inbound and outbound message audit and phone-link failure modes

nodes.label: NUS transport and RX line ring
nodes.summary: Nordic UART GATT service. Assembles lines (up to 2048 B) into an 8 KB PSRAM ring in the BLE host context; hal_phone_* exposes complete lines to the services layer.
nodes.runs: Written from nimble_host; read by phone_tick, at most 8 lines per tick.
nodes.note: Followup 6 - Gadgetbridge inbound and outbound message audit and phone-link failure modes

nodes.label: Wi-Fi station, setup AP, HTTP server, SNTP
nodes.summary: Station join with backoff, 600 s phone-setup AP, HTTP endpoints (/ota, /ota_url, /update, /notify) and SNTP. Credentials are checkpointed to wifi_cred.
nodes.runs: wifi-settings task (100 ms) plus retry/AP timers.

nodes.label: Radio admission control
nodes.summary: Starts or stops Wi-Fi and BLE from the saved nos_prefs intent, but only when internal heap allows; failed starts are retried after 5 s.
nodes.runs: Main loop, every pass (also with the screen off).

nodes.label: USB serial CDC, framing and guard
nodes.summary: Native USB Serial/JTAG link. LF framing (191 B cap, NUL+LF resync), usb_diag/usb_guard, reply bracket for req envelopes. About 130 text verbs ride on it.
nodes.runs: Read by the cmd task every 50 ms.
nodes.note: Followup 5 - USB command to handler map and host protocol edge cases

nodes.label: Strap HAL contract and presence mask
nodes.summary: hal_ext_* contract shared by all strap drivers, with a presence mask. Getters renew a last_get stamp; modules idle out 8 s after the last request. Strap code lives in firmware/main/ext.
nodes.runs: Serviced by the ext task, wakes at most every 50 ms.

nodes.label: MAX30102 HR driver (ext_hr)
nodes.summary: Streams red/IR FIFO into bpm/SpO2/quality/on-wrist and a 4 s PPG trace. Background 40 s reading every 10 min keeps a 144-sample history. Lease-driven; unverified hardware.
nodes.runs: ext task: FIFO every 120 ms with a lease, first background read +2 min after boot.

nodes.label: GNSS driver (ext_gps)
nodes.summary: NMEA parser with baud probing; supplies fix, altitude, hdop and age to Navigate tracks and outdoor workouts. Unverified hardware.
nodes.runs: ext task while a getter or owner keeps it alive.

nodes.label: LTE modem driver (ext_lte)
nodes.summary: AT scheduler: CSQ/CEREG/CREG/COPS about every 1.25 s, SMS inbox every 60 s, send SMS. No call audio. Unverified hardware.
nodes.runs: ext task, only while LTE is enabled or kept alive.

nodes.label: BME280 driver (ext_env)
nodes.summary: Forced-mode pressure/temperature/humidity read every 2 s, 24 h history one sample per 10 min, sea-level reference saved as ext_sea.
nodes.runs: ext task every 2 s, with no idle gate once present.

nodes.label: APDS-9960 driver (ext_light)
nodes.summary: Ambient light and proximity readout for Modules and sensor logs.
nodes.runs: ext task about every 400 ms.

nodes.label: Magnetometer driver (ext_mag)
nodes.summary: Heading and figure-8 calibration (hard/soft iron, axis map). Calibration saved as ext_mag only when the fit passes its checks.
nodes.runs: ext task; standby when no consumer.

nodes.label: Haptic driver (ext_haptic)
nodes.summary: Plays PWM vibration patterns and strength from prefs via a one-shot chained esp_timer. Used by alarms, notifications and feedback when the strap is present.
nodes.runs: haptic esp_timer chain, per pattern segment.

nodes.label: Audio driver (ext_audio)
nodes.summary: I2S speaker/mic for Recorder WAVs (16 kHz mono) and UI sounds. exta pumps I2S, extf owns the file I/O. Unverified hardware on B.
nodes.runs: exta (prio 3) 4 ms blocks and extf (prio 0) files, only while recording or playing.

nodes.label: Sleep park protocol
nodes.summary: At shutdown the board asks each strap module to PARK, waits for board-sense and board-fs acknowledgements and only then allows reboot or deep sleep.
nodes.runs: Shutdown path only.

nodes.label: IMU recorder HAL (imu_hal.c)
nodes.summary: Creates the imu-rate timer and the imu-sample and imu-write tasks for the manual CSV recorder at 25/50/100 Hz. Idle unless a recording was started.
nodes.runs: Only while a manual recording runs.

nodes.label: BLE battery history ring
nodes.summary: hal_batt_log_tick fills a 1440-entry mV ring but nothing in NOS ever calls it. Only a media command dump would read it.
nodes.runs: Never runs.

nodes.label: main / app_main UI loop
nodes.summary: Boot, power-state machine, serial command execution, touch drain, frame_run, DMA fence, prefs flush and frame pacing. Owns every screen and service tick.
nodes.runs: core 0, prio 1, 8192 B. ON about 60 Hz (40 Hz authored); AOD/SENSOR 1 Hz frames; OFF 50 Hz loop, no frames.

nodes.label: flush task
nodes.summary: Takes 16-row stripe jobs, rotates them CCW into small DMA buffers and draws over QSPI. Posts the DMA-done credit and handles JOB_FENCE and panel jobs.
nodes.runs: core 1, prio 4, 3 KB, queue depth 3. Per dirty stripe; idle when nothing changes.

nodes.label: touch task
nodes.summary: Polls the FT3168 and pushes points into a 16-entry ring that the UI loop drains. Also flags finger-down so the screen does not time out.
nodes.runs: core 1, prio 5. 10 ms ON, 40 ms (25 Hz) otherwise; keeps polling screen-off.

nodes.label: cmd task
nodes.summary: Reads USB serial lines, answers SDXFER inline, pumps ble_xfer_poll and queues other commands for the UI loop to execute.
nodes.runs: prio 4, 6144 B. Wakes every 50 ms, any display state.
nodes.note: Followup 5 - USB command to handler map and host protocol edge cases

nodes.label: dotbake task
nodes.summary: Boot-time prebake of dot-matrix masks and the orrery Q16 shade table so first frames do not stall. Exits when done.
nodes.runs: core 1, prio 1, 3 KB. Boot only.
nodes.note: Followup 4 - Uncovered built files- blur pipeline, orrery shade, fonts

nodes.label: board-sense task
nodes.summary: IMU loop (3 reads per cycle, about 150/s) fanning out to pedometer, wake, knock, wrist detect, workout motion and journal; also the 1 Hz battery sample and calendar-day refresh.
nodes.runs: prio 2, 4 KB static, no affinity. 20 ms cycle, always on, screen off included.

nodes.label: board-fs task
nodes.summary: Device retry, SD mount retry, pedometer NVS save (60 s, only when the display is not ON), RTC write-back, 60 s CSV log row and the shutdown final flush. Does not write prefs.
nodes.runs: prio 1, 4 KB. 100 ms loop, always on.

nodes.label: imu-sample task
nodes.summary: Reads IMU samples on each imu-rate timer tick for the manual recorder and hands records to imu-write.
nodes.runs: prio 3. 25/50/100 Hz, only while recording.

nodes.label: imu-write task
nodes.summary: Drains the recorder queue to /sdcard/imu/NNNN.csv, with segment rollover at 4 MiB.
nodes.runs: prio 1, 6 KB. 20 ms loop, only while recording.

nodes.label: sports_sd task
nodes.summary: Single SD writer for the sports journal: batches queued 64 B records into per-day events and per-hour raw sensor files, and answers journal queries.
nodes.runs: prio 1, 4 KB PSRAM, no affinity. 1 s drain, 512-record batch.

nodes.label: workout_sd task
nodes.summary: Writes the workout session image as alternating 4304 B checksummed banks with fsync and readback.
nodes.runs: prio 2, 6144 B. 500 ms loop; checkpoint every 30 s while running.

nodes.label: track_save task
nodes.summary: One-shot: writes the frozen GPS point array to /sdcard/watch/tracks/NNNN.gpx when a track stops.
nodes.runs: prio 1, 4 KB. One shot per track stop.

nodes.label: memo_scan task
nodes.summary: One-shot scan of the memo folder that builds the newest-24 list for Recorder.
nodes.runs: prio 1, 4 KB. One shot per scan.

nodes.label: asset-read task
nodes.summary: Reads asset files from SD off the UI thread (orrery textures under /sdcard/sky/).
nodes.runs: prio 1. On demand from the orrery card poll.

nodes.label: wifi-settings task
nodes.summary: Worker for scans, joins and the setup AP; checkpoints credentials to wifi_cred 5 s after a successful join.
nodes.runs: prio 2, 6144 B. 100 ms loop.

nodes.label: nimble_host task
nodes.summary: NimBLE host: GATT, NUS RX assembly into the 8 KB ring, scan, advertising and the control callout.
nodes.runs: core 0, prio configMAX_PRIORITIES-4. Event driven.

nodes.label: weather task
nodes.summary: Fetches Open-Meteo when Wi-Fi is up and a stored location exists. Nothing in the built NOS can set that location, so a fresh watch never fetches over Wi-Fi.
nodes.runs: prio 2, 8 KB. 1 s poll; fetch every 1800 s ok, 60 s on failure, 10 s minimum gap.

nodes.label: voice task
nodes.summary: Voice chat worker (record, STT, LLM, TTS). Compiled as stubs on the 1.43-B, so no task runs there.
nodes.runs: prio 3, 10 KB PSRAM on C only. Not running on B.

nodes.label: ota-upload task
nodes.summary: Receives a firmware image over HTTP and writes the inactive OTA slot. Blocked while a workout, track or voice session is active.
nodes.runs: prio 5, 4 KB. Per HTTP /ota upload.

nodes.label: ota_url task
nodes.summary: Downloads a firmware image from a URL via esp_https_ota into the inactive slot.
nodes.runs: prio 5, 8 KB. Per /ota_url request.

nodes.label: ext task (strap service)
nodes.summary: Services every present strap driver in turn (env, light, mag, HR, GPS, LTE) and renews idle expiry. Without straps it mostly idles.
nodes.runs: prio 0, 4 KB PSRAM, unpinned. Wakes at most every 50 ms; some modules run with the screen off.

nodes.label: exta audio task
nodes.summary: Pumps I2S PCM in and out for recording and playback.
nodes.runs: prio 3, 4 KB. 4 ms blocks while needed.

nodes.label: extf audio file task
nodes.summary: Owns audio file I/O (WAV create, finalise, play) so recordings survive leaving the screen.
nodes.runs: prio 0, 4 KB. On demand.

nodes.label: pace esp_timer (frame pacing)
nodes.summary: Releases a semaphore at the frame period so the UI loop paces at the fps cap (default 60 Hz) when the display is ON.
nodes.runs: esp_timer, 1/fps_cap. Running only while the display is ON.

nodes.label: haptic esp_timer
nodes.summary: One-shot timer chained per segment of a vibration pattern.
nodes.runs: esp_timer, per pattern segment.

nodes.label: wifi_retry esp_timer
nodes.summary: Reconnect backoff for the station link, 2 s doubling to 300 s.
nodes.runs: esp_timer, while Wi-Fi wants a link and is down.

nodes.label: wifi_ap esp_timer
nodes.summary: Stops the phone-setup access point after 10 minutes.
nodes.runs: esp_timer, 600 s one-shot per setup session.

nodes.label: airhop esp_timer
nodes.summary: Channel hop for a Wi-Fi air-utilisation monitor. hal_wifi_air_start has no caller in the built NOS, so this timer is never created.
nodes.runs: Never runs.

nodes.label: imu-rate esp_timer
nodes.summary: Periodic timer that clocks imu-sample at the recorder rate.
nodes.runs: esp_timer, 1e6/hz us, only while recording.

nodes.label: ble_control_tick callout
nodes.summary: NimBLE callout that runs connection and advertising control (parameters, reconnect, pending requests).
nodes.runs: NimBLE callout, every 100 ms.

nodes.label: nos_frame_run / frame_run
nodes.summary: Per-frame pipeline: input, nos_bg_tick, transitions, tick of the top screens, overlays, damage diff, stripe render and flush. dt is bounded to 100 ms; authored clock 40 Hz, present 60 Hz.
nodes.runs: Called by the UI task each ON frame; 1 Hz in AOD/SENSOR; not called in OFF.

nodes.label: Screen stack and transitions
nodes.summary: 8-deep push/pop/replace/home stack with PUSH, RISE, DROP, IRIS and DISSOLVE transitions, finger-owned back-swipe and banner/toast overlays. Only the top (or under/over) screens tick.
nodes.runs: Driven from frame_run; no task of its own.

nodes.label: Input recogniser and router
nodes.summary: Turns touch points and button edges into taps, drags, back-swipes, click/double/long press and air gestures; applies the knock lock.
nodes.runs: UI task, every frame.

nodes.label: Frame pacer
nodes.summary: Waits on the pace-timer semaphore to hold the fps cap (24/30/40/48/60/unlimited; default 60) with a 30 fps floor.
nodes.runs: UI task, once per ON frame.

nodes.label: Display power states ON/AOD/SENSOR/OFF
nodes.summary: State machine in the UI loop. ON renders; AOD/SENSOR draw 1 Hz frames at 80 MHz; OFF draws nothing but still ticks services at 1 Hz. Default idle target is SENSOR (sensor_idle=1, aod=0).
nodes.runs: UI task loop, every pass (20 ms delay when not ON).

nodes.label: DFS / PM locks (80-240 MHz)
nodes.summary: esp_pm: the UI loop holds an nos-ui lock per iteration (240 MHz) and drops to 80 MHz in the gaps. OFF and SENSOR cap the maximum at 80 MHz.
nodes.runs: UI task, around each loop iteration.

nodes.label: Live pref application
nodes.summary: Main-loop code that applies nos_prefs changes: radio intent, timezone/calendar, TE, wrist sync, theme, brightness, sleep timeout, fps cap. Also runs the prefs_tick checkpoint.
nodes.runs: UI task, every loop pass including screen off.

nodes.label: App registry and boot
nodes.summary: Static table of 28 launcher entries, nos_open (remembers the last app for a double press), nos_apps_boot and services_tick = svc_tick + background_tick.
nodes.runs: Library code on the UI task.

nodes.label: Scene record, damage diff and stripe raster
nodes.summary: Screens draw into a recorded command list; commands are hashed and diffed against the last frame, then only damaged 16-row stripes are rasterised into DRAM stripe buffers.
nodes.runs: UI task, each presented frame (AOD 1 Hz).

nodes.label: Band damage
nodes.summary: Refines damage into narrower bands per stripe. Present but only partly used on this build.
nodes.runs: UI task during render.

nodes.label: Layer cache (retained rasters)
nodes.summary: Keeps up to three full-screen rasters in PSRAM so a retained screen can be blitted instead of redrawn. Disabled while an active directional blur is running.
nodes.runs: UI task during render.

nodes.label: Live motion blur gate and kernels
nodes.summary: Budget gate and horizontal/vertical box-blur kernels for transitions. Gated off on device by NOS_RENDER_SHARP=1, so the live blur path does not run.
nodes.runs: UI task during render; skipped on device.
nodes.note: Followup 4 - Uncovered built files- blur pipeline, orrery shade, fonts

nodes.label: Directional list blur cache (ui_blur)
nodes.summary: Cached directional blur for scrolling lists. Its PSRAM arena is never allocated on the device.
nodes.runs: Never runs on device.
nodes.note: Followup 4 - Uncovered built files- blur pipeline, orrery shade, fonts

nodes.label: Persistent page blur (pblur)
nodes.summary: Baked blurred page slots used by the Control Center drop transition in the blur design. Dead on device.
nodes.runs: Never runs on device.
nodes.note: Followup 4 - Uncovered built files- blur pipeline, orrery shade, fonts

nodes.label: Notification card blur cache (kblur)
nodes.summary: Bakes blurred notification card backdrops into an 896 KiB PSRAM arena (about six slots). Still bakes even though the live blur path is off.
nodes.runs: UI task when notification cards are shown.
nodes.note: Followup 4 - Uncovered built files- blur pipeline, orrery shade, fonts

nodes.label: Settings shutter blur helper
nodes.summary: Blur helper used for the Settings list reveal.
nodes.runs: UI task while Settings opens.

nodes.label: Dot-matrix renderer
nodes.summary: Draws the Nothing-style dot glyphs and icons from prebaked PSRAM masks (about 550 KB).
nodes.runs: UI task during render; masks baked by dotbake at boot.

nodes.label: Arc text masks
nodes.summary: Curved text and ring masks cached in PSRAM (448 KB cap).
nodes.runs: UI task during render.

nodes.label: gfx / font / sprite primitives
nodes.summary: Low-level fill, blit, text, sprite and animation primitives that all screens draw with.
nodes.runs: Library code on the UI task.

nodes.label: nf_* baked fonts
nodes.summary: Baked font tables in flash .rodata (about 281 KB) generated by tools/bake_font.py.
nodes.runs: Read during render.
nodes.note: Followup 4 - Uncovered built files- blur pipeline, orrery shade, fonts

nodes.label: Native menu assets
nodes.summary: Large flash blob of menu pixels unpacked into a PSRAM arena for fast list drawing; rebuilt when art, fonts or the registry change.
nodes.runs: UI task during render.

nodes.label: PSRAM allocator and budget
nodes.summary: Tracks 64 PSRAM owners against a 6656 KiB budget. Feeds the layer cache, masks, history and journal buffers.
nodes.runs: Library code, any task.

nodes.label: Motion primitives
nodes.summary: Curves, springs and per-frame step helpers that keep animation clock-based at M_FPS = NOS_FPS = 40.
nodes.runs: UI task, per frame.

nodes.label: Orrery Q16 shade table and card shade
nodes.summary: Q16 lighting multipliers (512 entries) and the card shade consumers for the Solar face, prebaked at boot.
nodes.runs: dotbake at boot; read during orrery render.
nodes.note: Followup 4 - Uncovered built files- blur pipeline, orrery shade, fonts

nodes.label: Ephemeris (core/ephem.c)
nodes.summary: Planet and Sun positions from the Julian date for the Solar face.
nodes.runs: UI task each orrery frame.

nodes.label: Render diagnostics and bench switches
nodes.summary: USB switches (cache_packed, layers, native_stage, card_*), mblur bench, capture/probe tooling and the render cost profiler. Developer use only.
nodes.runs: On USB command.
nodes.note: Followup 4 - Uncovered built files- blur pipeline, orrery shade, fonts

nodes.label: Services hub (svc_init / svc_tick)
nodes.summary: services_tick = svc_tick + background_tick, installed as nos_bg_tick. Drains phone lines, then 1 s slow path (sys_tick, act_tick, sports_tick), heart every 60 s, weather check every 10 s, alarms, timer, stopwatch, tracks.
nodes.runs: UI task. Every frame when ON; once a second in OFF, AOD and SENSOR.

nodes.label: Gadgetbridge protocol handler (gb.c)
nodes.summary: Parses GB JSON lines. Handles notify, notify~, notify-, call, musicinfo, musicstate, weather, find, alarm, act, vibrate, is_gps_active, setTime, E.setTimeZone. Ignores calendar, nav, gps, http, intent, actfetch.
nodes.runs: Per line in phone_tick, at most 8 lines per tick.
nodes.note: Followup 6 - Gadgetbridge inbound and outbound message audit and phone-link failure modes

nodes.label: Phone line pump and status reporter
nodes.summary: phone_tick: drains NUS lines, tracks connection, sends ver (500 ms after connect), status every 10 min or on a 5 percent/charger change, and the act reply.
nodes.runs: svc_tick on the UI task.
nodes.note: Followup 6 - Gadgetbridge inbound and outbound message audit and phone-link failure modes

nodes.label: Notifications service
nodes.summary: Stores up to 20 notifications, raises the banner, tracks unread, and sends DISMISS/OPEN back to the phone. Companion bridge posts (title only) are added the same way. RAM only.
nodes.runs: svc_tick; banner pushed in the same tick.
nodes.note: Followup 6 - Gadgetbridge inbound and outbound message audit and phone-link failure modes

nodes.label: Music service
nodes.summary: Holds track, artist, state, position and volume from musicinfo/musicstate (or the companion bridge) and sends play/pause/next/previous/volume commands back.
nodes.runs: svc_tick; phone re-sends state after each link.

nodes.label: Weather service (source merge)
nodes.summary: Takes phone weather when it is under 3 h old, else the Wi-Fi fetch snapshot. Exposes temp, feels-like, condition, 12 h and daily forecast. RAM only.
nodes.runs: svc_tick wx_tick, checked every 10 s.

nodes.label: Open-Meteo fetcher (weather_service.c)
nodes.summary: Requests the forecast for a stored lat/lon. hal_weather_set_location has no caller in the built firmware (only legacy main.c), so without a pre-existing weather_loc key the Wi-Fi path never fetches.
nodes.runs: weather task; needs Wi-Fi up, a location and a clock.

nodes.label: Activity service (svc_activity)
nodes.summary: Turns pedometer output into daily steps, km, kcal (steps x 0.04, no basal term), hourly bins, active minutes and a 7-day week. Rollover at midnight; nosact checkpoint.
nodes.runs: act_tick 1 Hz on the UI task, also screen off. Checkpoint every 10 min when dirty.

nodes.label: Pedometer and walk detector
nodes.summary: Counts steps from the 3 Hz-filtered IMU with a walk detector and local-day gate. Publishes steps, active seconds, walking and valid; saved as a 24 B day record.
nodes.runs: board-sense every 20 ms; calendar day re-checked at most 1 Hz.

nodes.label: Heart aggregation service
nodes.summary: Combines the live locked reading, the 10-minute background history and per-day min/max/resting into svc_heart_t. Needs the HR strap; RAM only.
nodes.runs: heart_tick every 60 s on the UI task.

nodes.label: Guided wrist-side detector
nodes.summary: A 4 s guided capture from the IMU that infers which wrist the watch is on for Sports setup.
nodes.runs: Only while Sports DETECT WRIST is open.

nodes.label: Alarms service
nodes.summary: Eight alarms with repeat days, snooze (9 min) and phone replacement. Fires from the services tick so alarms ring with the app closed. Saved as nosalarm.
nodes.runs: alarm_tick in svc_tick; 1 Hz screen-off.

nodes.label: Timer service
nodes.summary: Countdown on a monotonic clock; rings the TIME'S UP screen when done. RAM only, lost at reboot.
nodes.runs: svc_tick each frame, 1 Hz screen off.

nodes.label: Stopwatch service
nodes.summary: Start/stop/lap/reset with up to 30 laps. RAM only.
nodes.runs: svc_tick; time base survives leaving the app.

nodes.label: Ringer and ring-screen manager
nodes.summary: Priority arbiter find > call > alarm > timer: pushes the ring screens, fires haptic/sound every 2 s and keeps the display awake (SCR_KEEPAWAKE). Ring timeout 60 s, find-watch 120 s.
nodes.runs: svc_tick.

nodes.label: Calls service (Gadgetbridge call state)
nodes.summary: Incoming/started/ended call state from the phone; ACCEPT/REJECT/END go back as GB lines. No call audio and no call log.
nodes.runs: svc_tick.

nodes.label: Find phone / find watch
nodes.summary: Sends findPhone true/false and holds the find-watch ring flag set by a GB find line. The phone never confirms.
nodes.runs: svc_tick.

nodes.label: System status service (svc_sys)
nodes.summary: Mirrors battery percent/charging/rail, phone and Wi-Fi flags and feeds the phone status JSON. Valid only when the sampler is.
nodes.runs: sys_tick 1 Hz.

nodes.label: Phone time and timezone sync
nodes.summary: Applies setTime epoch and E.setTimeZone from the phone and overwrites tz_min in prefs.
nodes.runs: On message, in phone_tick.
nodes.note: Followup 1 - Time source, RTC trust and midnight rollover end to end

nodes.label: System clock and timezone (hal)
nodes.summary: Owns time(), TZ from prefs, setters used by phone time, SNTP and Set time, and raises board_clock_changed so the RTC gets rewritten.
nodes.runs: Library code; frame-latched datetime for the UI.
nodes.note: Followup 1 - Time source, RTC trust and midnight rollover end to end

nodes.label: Pedometer calendar gate
nodes.summary: Derives the local date from time()+tz and closes the pedometer gate while the timezone changes, so steps roll over at local midnight.
nodes.runs: board-sense, at most once per second.
nodes.note: Followup 1 - Time source, RTC trust and midnight rollover end to end

nodes.label: GPS track recorder
nodes.summary: Samples GNSS fixes into a 4096-point PSRAM array, tracks distance and elapsed, and hands the array to track_save on stop. Needs the GPS strap.
nodes.runs: svc_tick; keeps recording with Navigate closed.

nodes.label: Voice memo service
nodes.summary: Recording state and elapsed time for Recorder; drives the audio driver and names files M_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_NNNN.wav from UTC.
nodes.runs: svc_tick; recording continues when the screen closes.

nodes.label: Cellular status shim (svc_cell_tick)
nodes.summary: A small tick inside con_cell.c that latches the SMS send outcome. All modem logic is in the ext_lte driver.
nodes.runs: Called from the Cellular screen tick.

nodes.label: Companion notification/media bridge
nodes.summary: Accepts 0xF2 BLE frames and unauthenticated HTTP POST /notify as notifications (app|title, no body) and media info for Music.
nodes.runs: BLE host / HTTP server context, drained in svc_tick.
nodes.note: Followup 6 - Gadgetbridge inbound and outbound message audit and phone-link failure modes

nodes.label: Sports journal (sensor/event logger)
nodes.summary: Queues 64 B checksummed records (SP_IMU, SP_ACTIVITY, SP_HEART, SP_BATTERY, SP_POWER, SP_WAKE, ...) and answers journal queries. Also holds food/water and marker ledgers.
nodes.runs: sports_tick 1 Hz; 60 s records; IMU records from board-sense.

nodes.label: Workout session engine
nodes.summary: Runs sessions (start/pause/lap/finish), samples HR/steps/motion at 1 Hz, estimates energy_kcal_est = MET*3.5*kg/200*min and saves banks. That kcal is shown only in Sports DETAILS and Jobs, never merged into daily Activity.
nodes.runs: workout_tick in svc_tick; 1 Hz screen off; checkpoint 30 s.

nodes.label: Wrist movement episode detector
nodes.summary: Finds valid-motion bursts from the ~150 Hz IMU for racket/hand sports and feeds valid_ms, movement_ms and bursts to the workout.
nodes.runs: board-sense per sample.

nodes.label: Manual IMU CSV recorder
nodes.summary: Start/stop and segmentation of /sdcard/imu/NNNN.csv recordings with intent banks and link files.
nodes.runs: Only when started from the IMU app.

nodes.label: Background jobs monitor
nodes.summary: Tracks 13 job states (motion, steps, calorie estimate, battery, journal, IMU recording, sports session, five strap jobs) with a 2-minute RAM history.
nodes.runs: background_tick, internally 1 Hz.

nodes.label: Diagnostics log
nodes.summary: Checked ring of power, wake, command and fault events; 30 s samples; keeps retained RTC fault slots.
nodes.runs: diag_log_tick on the UI task every 30 s; written by the sports_sd task.

nodes.label: Heap diagnostics
nodes.summary: Records heap failure history in RTC_NOINIT (8 slots) and wraps allocation failure hooks.
nodes.runs: UI task, 1 Hz.

nodes.label: SD transfer service (SDXFER v=2)
nodes.summary: Eight transfer verbs over USB or BLE to list, get and put SD files. A raw settings put passes the prefs restore gate; mutation is blocked during OTA.
nodes.runs: Executed on the cmd task, any display state.
nodes.note: Followup 5 - USB command to handler map and host protocol edge cases

nodes.label: BLE XFR transfer service
nodes.summary: GATT service that carries SDXFER commands and file data over BLE.
nodes.runs: ble_xfer_poll on the cmd task, 50 ms.
nodes.note: Followup 5 - USB command to handler map and host protocol edge cases

nodes.label: OTA updater
nodes.summary: Writes the inactive 0x780000 app slot over HTTP upload or URL. Refuses while a workout, track or voice session is active or while SD mutation is in scope.
nodes.runs: ota-upload / ota_url tasks.

nodes.label: Voice chat engine (C board only)
nodes.summary: Push-to-talk assistant using the C board codec. Stubbed on B, so Chat shows 'needs the C board mic and speaker'.
nodes.runs: Not running on B.

nodes.label: Preferences service (nos_prefs)
nodes.summary: Owns the 52 B nos_prefs struct, defaults, migration and the debounced prefs_tick checkpoint (2 s quiet, 10 s max, retry 5 s) to SD banks with an NVS mirror and prefs_overlay.
nodes.runs: prefs_tick on the UI task, only when the persistence window is open.

nodes.label: SD settings bank writer
nodes.summary: Alternating checksummed 276 B banks settings.0/1.bin with fsync and readback, taken under the mount lease and SD lock.
nodes.runs: Inline in prefs_flush on the UI task.

nodes.label: Gesture tuning
nodes.summary: Walk and knock thresholds (sportstune, 20 B) read by the pedometer and knock detector.
nodes.runs: Read on every IMU sample.

nodes.label: Power policy
nodes.summary: Decides the idle target (SENSOR by default, AOD if set, OFF otherwise), the low-battery latch (enter at 15 percent or below, leave at 20 percent or above) and whether a wake request is allowed.
nodes.runs: UI task each loop pass.

nodes.label: Wake service (config, learn, tick)
nodes.summary: Raise-to-wake configuration (wake_cfg), learning and per-pass evaluation when the display is not ON. Gated by raise_wake, unlocked, not low battery.
nodes.runs: UI task every pass (about 50 Hz) when display not ON.

nodes.label: Raise-to-wake detector
nodes.summary: Pickup/turn gesture detector fed by the 3 Hz-filtered IMU.
nodes.runs: Per sample from wake service.

nodes.label: Double-knock detector
nodes.summary: Detects knocks from raw accel and gyro at about 150 Hz; wakes the display or toggles the lock when knock_lock is set.
nodes.runs: board-sense per sample.

nodes.label: Restart / Power off
nodes.summary: Guarded shutdown: refuses while a workout, track or OTA is active, flushes prefs, parks board tasks and straps, then esp_restart or GPIO0 deep sleep.
nodes.runs: UI task on user action.

nodes.label: USB command dispatcher (cmd_exec)
nodes.summary: Executes about 130 text verbs and the req <id> envelope on the UI loop: prefs, gb injection, ext debug, batcal, diag, open screens. Chat verbs are stubs on B.
nodes.runs: UI task, drained each loop pass.
nodes.note: Followup 5 - USB command to handler map and host protocol edge cases

nodes.label: Legacy cfg blob (core/settings.c)
nodes.summary: Old 40 B 'cfg' blob loaded once at boot (backlight 200, wake_service_init). Nothing writes it now.
nodes.runs: Boot once.
nodes.note: Followup 3 - Complete NVS key and legacy-store ownership including core-apps legacy keys

nodes.label: Legacy core/ UI, Pip and main.c
nodes.summary: Compiled but unused: core/notif.c ring and core/battery.c adapter. Not in the build: core/apps, Pip pet, main.c. Leaves orphaned NVS keys (alarms, pip_*, lcd_gap).
nodes.runs: Never runs.
nodes.note: Followup 3 - Complete NVS key and legacy-store ownership including core-apps legacy keys

nodes.label: nos_prefs (RAM struct)
nodes.summary: 52 B in-RAM preference struct loaded at boot (SD banks first, NVS fallback). Defaults: aod 0, sensor_idle 1, fps_cap 60, face 0. Lost only if a save never lands.
nodes.runs: RAM. Read by the engine every frame; written by apps then prefs_save().

nodes.label: SD settings banks (settings.0/1.bin)
nodes.summary: Authoritative copy of nosprefs on SD at /sdcard/watch/settings.0.bin and .1.bin: alternating checksummed 276 B banks with fsync and readback.
nodes.runs: SD. Written by prefs_flush; loaded into RAM at boot.

nodes.label: NVS nosprefs mirror
nodes.summary: NVS blob 'nosprefs' in namespace wos: migration source and card-absent fallback for the preferences.
nodes.runs: NVS. Written with the SD checkpoint; read at boot if SD is absent.
nodes.note: Followup 3 - Complete NVS key and legacy-store ownership including core-apps legacy keys

nodes.label: NVS prefs_overlay
nodes.summary: Small NVS overlay of runtime-adjusted prefs kept alongside nosprefs.
nodes.runs: NVS. Written by the prefs service.
nodes.note: Followup 3 - Complete NVS key and legacy-store ownership including core-apps legacy keys

nodes.label: Wi-Fi credentials (SD + NVS mirror)
nodes.summary: 98 B wifi_cred checkpointed to SD /watch/wifi/ banks with an NVS mirror. Credentials stay out of board records.
nodes.runs: SD/NVS. Written 5 s after a successful join.
nodes.note: Followup 3 - Complete NVS key and legacy-store ownership including core-apps legacy keys

nodes.label: NVS pedometer (24 B)
nodes.summary: Today's step record (version, day key, count) saved by board-fs every 60 s when dirty and only while the display is not ON; restored at boot.
nodes.runs: NVS. 60 s, retry 5 s, plus shutdown flush.

nodes.label: NVS nosact (activity history)
nodes.summary: 92 B v2 blob holding day/week/hourly/active-minute history. Written by act_save on the UI task: dirty and 10 min, immediately at midnight.
nodes.runs: NVS. In-frame commit.

nodes.label: NVS nosalarm (164 B)
nodes.summary: Eight 20 B alarm records plus count and version.
nodes.runs: NVS. Written on each alarm edit; loaded at boot.

nodes.label: NVS nos_wc (world clock)
nodes.summary: 6 B blob of up to four favourite city indices. Written without readback.
nodes.runs: NVS. On favourite change.

nodes.label: NVS sportsfood + sportsmarks
nodes.summary: Food/water intake ledger (8200 B) and labelled quick-report markers (1032 B).
nodes.runs: NVS. On intake or marker edits.

nodes.label: NVS sportstune (gesture tuning)
nodes.summary: 20 B of walk and knock thresholds.
nodes.runs: NVS. On Wrist tuning change.

nodes.label: NVS wake_cfg
nodes.summary: 48 B FNV-1a-checked raise-to-wake configuration written when the wake learn finishes.
nodes.runs: NVS. On change.

nodes.label: NVS ext_mag + ext_sea
nodes.summary: Compass calibration (36 B) and barometer sea-level reference (4 B).
nodes.runs: NVS. On a passing calibration or sea-level change.
nodes.note: Followup 3 - Complete NVS key and legacy-store ownership including core-apps legacy keys

nodes.label: NVS bat_cal
nodes.summary: Battery calibration offset (4 B mV) written by the batcal command.
nodes.runs: NVS. On batcal.

nodes.label: NVS weather_loc (44 B)
nodes.summary: Latitude, longitude and city for the Wi-Fi forecast. The only writer is hal_weather_set_location, which nothing in the built NOS calls, so the key stays empty.
nodes.runs: NVS. Read at weather task start.
nodes.note: Followup 3 - Complete NVS key and legacy-store ownership including core-apps legacy keys

nodes.label: NVS voice_chat + voice_hist (C only)
nodes.summary: Voice config and a 3892 B checksummed chat history on the C board. Unused on B.
nodes.runs: NVS. C board only.
nodes.note: Followup 3 - Complete NVS key and legacy-store ownership including core-apps legacy keys

nodes.label: NVS orphaned legacy keys
nodes.summary: cfg (40 B, read at boot), alarms, pip_memory, pip_care_a/b and lcd_gap. Left over from the old UI; nothing current writes them.
nodes.runs: NVS. Inert.
nodes.note: Followup 3 - Complete NVS key and legacy-store ownership including core-apps legacy keys

nodes.label: NVS phy (RF calibration)
nodes.summary: ESP-IDF RF calibration namespace (cal_version, cal_mac, cal_data 1904 B). Owned by esp_phy, not NOS.
nodes.runs: NVS. Written by the radio driver.
nodes.note: Followup 3 - Complete NVS key and legacy-store ownership including core-apps legacy keys

nodes.label: SD sports journal (.spt)
nodes.summary: /sdcard/watch/sports/YYYYMMDD-events.spt and YYYYMMDD-HH-sensors.spt of 64 B checksummed records: activity, battery, power, wake, heart, raw IMU/ENV/GPS.
nodes.runs: SD. Drained every 1 s by sports_sd.

nodes.label: SD workouts banks
nodes.summary: /sdcard/watch/workouts/workouts.0.bin and .1.bin: alternating 4304 B checksummed session and history banks. A RUNNING session restores as PAUSED.
nodes.runs: SD. Checkpoint 30 s while running.

nodes.label: SD IMU recordings
nodes.summary: /sdcard/imu/NNNN.csv (4 MiB segments), .link files and intent.0/1.bin banks.
nodes.runs: SD. While recording.

nodes.label: SD GPX tracks
nodes.summary: /sdcard/watch/tracks/NNNN.gpx written once per track stop.
nodes.runs: SD. On stop.

nodes.label: SD voice memos (WAV)
nodes.summary: /sdcard/watch/memos/M_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_NNNN.wav, 16 kHz mono. .part files from interrupted recordings are never recovered.
nodes.runs: SD. While recording.

nodes.label: SD diagnostics ring (diag-NN.bin)
nodes.summary: /sdcard/watch/diagnostics/diag-00..07.bin DLG1 ring files for power samples and state changes.
nodes.runs: SD. 30 s samples.

nodes.label: SD minute CSV logs
nodes.summary: /sdcard/watch/logs/*.csv: one battery/IMU row per minute from board-fs.
nodes.runs: SD. 60 s (retry 1 s if busy).

nodes.label: SD orrery textures (/sky)
nodes.summary: /sdcard/sky/*.565 and *.rgba planet textures provisioned by hand; read-only for the watch.
nodes.runs: SD. Read on demand.

nodes.label: Orrery static sky pack (flash)
nodes.summary: Compiled-in belt, comets, spacecraft and event data (od_pack_jd 2461327.5, built 2026-10-14).
nodes.runs: Flash. Read-only.

nodes.label: nf_* font tables (flash .rodata)
nodes.summary: About 281 KB of baked glyph tables.
nodes.runs: Flash. Read-only.
nodes.note: Followup 4 - Uncovered built files- blur pipeline, orrery shade, fonts

nodes.label: PCF85063 calendar registers
nodes.summary: BCD UTC at registers 0x04-0x0A. Trusted at boot only if the OS and 12-hour bits are clear.
nodes.runs: RTC chip. Written by rtc_maintain.
nodes.note: Followup 1 - Time source, RTC trust and midnight rollover end to end

nodes.label: Retained RTC RAM (diag, heap fails)
nodes.summary: RTC RAM and RTC_NOINIT: fault slots, breadcrumbs and eight heap-failure slots that survive a warm reboot.
nodes.runs: RTC RAM. Written by diag and heap hooks.

nodes.label: Coredump partition
nodes.summary: Flash partition written by the panic handler and read by host tools.
nodes.runs: Flash. On crash.

nodes.label: OTA app slots (2 x 0x780000)
nodes.summary: Two OTA slots, the first at 0x20000. OTA writes the inactive one; NVS is preserved.
nodes.runs: Flash. On OTA.

nodes.label: Notification store (PSRAM)
nodes.summary: svc_big block of about 10 KB: 20 x svc_notif (236 B) plus phone flags. Cleared at boot, never persisted.
nodes.runs: PSRAM. Written by svc_tick.

nodes.label: NUS RX line ring (8 KB PSRAM)
nodes.summary: [len:2][bytes] records written by the BLE host and drained by phone_tick; mutex guarded. A 2048 B assembler sits in front.
nodes.runs: PSRAM. BLE writes, svc_tick reads.
nodes.note: Followup 6 - Gadgetbridge inbound and outbound message audit and phone-link failure modes

nodes.label: RAM-only service state
nodes.summary: Static structs for timer, stopwatch, music, weather, heart, call and find state. All lost at reboot.
nodes.runs: RAM.

nodes.label: HR history ring (144 samples)
nodes.summary: One bpm per 10 minutes for 24 h in PSRAM, plus the svc_heart day min/max. Lost at reboot.
nodes.runs: PSRAM. Written by the ext task.

nodes.label: SMS inbox (RAM)
nodes.summary: Driver inbox of 12 messages and a UI list of 16 plus unread count.
nodes.runs: RAM. LTE strap only.

nodes.label: Background-job history (PSRAM)
nodes.summary: 13 x 2.8 KB job histories for the Jobs app. Cleared at reboot.
nodes.runs: PSRAM. 1 Hz.

nodes.label: Touch ring (16 entries)
nodes.summary: Ring handed from the touch task to the UI loop's touch_drain.
nodes.runs: RAM.

nodes.label: BLE battery mV ring (unused)
nodes.summary: 1440 x mV ring that nothing fills.
nodes.runs: RAM. Never written.

nodes.label: Stripe buffers (2 x 16 rows, DRAM)
nodes.summary: Internal-DRAM stripe framebuffers that the renderer fills and the flush task consumes. Internal DRAM is nearly full.
nodes.runs: DRAM.

nodes.label: DMA rotate buffers (2 x 8 rows)
nodes.summary: DMA-capable buffers where the flush task writes the CCW-rotated stripe before QSPI transfer.
nodes.runs: DRAM.

nodes.label: gfx_rec command record
nodes.summary: Up to 320 recorded draw commands with bounding boxes and hashes used for damage diffing.
nodes.runs: RAM.

nodes.label: Layer cache rasters (3 x 434 KB)
nodes.summary: Three retained 466x466 rasters in PSRAM.
nodes.runs: PSRAM.

nodes.label: Dot masks (PSRAM)
nodes.summary: About 550 KB of prebaked dot glyph masks.
nodes.runs: PSRAM. Baked at boot.

nodes.label: Arc text masks (PSRAM)
nodes.summary: Curved-text masks capped at 448 KB.
nodes.runs: PSRAM.

nodes.label: Native menu arena (PSRAM)
nodes.summary: Unpack arena for the menu pixel blob.
nodes.runs: PSRAM.

nodes.label: Blur arenas (kblur / pblur / ui_blur)
nodes.summary: kblur keeps 896 KiB of card slots. pblur (about 0.9 MB) and the ui_blur arena (up to 2.6 MB) are never allocated on device.
nodes.runs: PSRAM. Only kblur allocates.
nodes.note: Followup 4 - Uncovered built files- blur pipeline, orrery shade, fonts

nodes.label: Activity
nodes.summary: Three-page steps pager: hero ring toward the goal, today (km, kcal, active minutes, 24 h chart) and a 7-day view. Also Home widget slot 2. Owns no data; draws svc_activity().
nodes.runs: UI task, only while it is the top screen (or in a transition). Step pipeline runs regardless of screen.

nodes.label: Sports
nodes.summary: Workout screen: pick a profile, start, pause, lap, finish, history and details, plus body mass and wrist setup. Sessions keep running when you leave. Workout kcal is shown here only.
nodes.runs: UI task, only while it is the top screen (or in a transition). The recorder itself runs from svc_tick.

nodes.label: Energy
nodes.summary: Daily steps-based kcal, food and water totals and a 24-bin chart from the sports journal, with zoom. Burn is cumulative steps x 0.04; workout kcal is not included.
nodes.runs: UI task, only while it is the top screen (or in a transition). History refresh every 10 s.

nodes.label: Battery history
nodes.summary: 24-bin level or mV chart from the sports journal, with an IDLE 80 MHz toggle (sensor_idle) and records opened from Jobs.
nodes.runs: UI task, only while it is the top screen (or in a transition). Journal query every 10 s.

nodes.label: Sensor logs
nodes.summary: Browser for the event and raw sensor journals on SD.
nodes.runs: UI task, only while it is the top screen (or in a transition). 1 s logs poll.

nodes.label: Quick report
nodes.summary: Writes an unlabelled, then labelled, look-back marker into the journal for later analysis.
nodes.runs: UI task, only while it is the top screen (or in a transition).

nodes.label: Wrist tuning
nodes.summary: Adjusts walk and knock thresholds, runs wake learning and labelled trials.
nodes.runs: UI task, only while it is the top screen (or in a transition).

nodes.label: Jobs
nodes.summary: Read-only status board for 13 background jobs with state, age, count, three values and a 2-minute graph. Changes nothing and persists nothing.
nodes.runs: UI task, only while it is the top screen (or in a transition). Collector itself runs 1 Hz from nos_bg_tick.

nodes.label: Chat
nodes.summary: Push-to-talk voice assistant. On the 1.43-B the service is stubbed, the screen says it needs the C board mic and speaker and its controls do nothing.
nodes.runs: UI task, only while it is the top screen (or in a transition). Carries SCR_KEEPAWAKE.

nodes.label: Heart rate
nodes.summary: Live HR and SpO2 from the MAX30102 strap with a LOCKED state, plus a LAST 24 H page from 10-minute readings. Also the Home heart widget. Shows nothing without the strap.
nodes.runs: UI task, only while it is the top screen (or in a transition). Widget refresh when history older than 60 s.

nodes.label: Breathe
nodes.summary: Paced breathing (4 s in, 2 s hold, 6 s out) for 1, 3 or 5 minutes with haptics and a summary; writes the session average HR into the RAM heart state.
nodes.runs: UI task, only while it is the top screen (or in a transition).

nodes.label: Weather
nodes.summary: Now / next hours / days forecast and the Home widget. Draws svc_weather(), fed by phone pushes (3 h freshness) or the Wi-Fi fetch. Adds a BME280 temperature line when present.

flows.title: Step counting -> daily activity -> Activity/Energy UI -> persistence -> phone sync

steps.action: QMI8658 runs at 500 Hz; board-sense reads an accel/gyro burst about 150 times per second.
20 ms loop filters the sample to 3 Hz and hands it to the pedometer; runs with the screen off. It also supplies the local day key via the calendar gate.
Local date from time() + timezone; the count rolls over at local midnight and the gate closes while the timezone changes.
Walk detector and step counter publish steps, active seconds, walking and valid (valid needs an IMU sample under 250 ms old).
act_tick at 1 Hz (also screen off): km, kcal = steps x 0.04, hourly bins, active minute, 7-day week, midnight rollover.
Activity copies svc_activity() each tick: steps hero ring, today page (km, kcal, active min, 24 h chart) and week page.
Energy shows today's kcal and burn bins built from SP_ACTIVITY journal records.
Every 60 s, only while the display is not ON, saves the 24 B pedometer record; a shutdown flush saves the final count.
act_save on the UI task writes nosact (day, week, hourly, active minutes) when dirty after 10 min, and immediately at midnight.
After the phone sends {t:act}, phone_tick pushes {t:act, stp delta, hrm} every N seconds.
Outbound GB line is written to the Nordic UART TX characteristic.
Gadgetbridge records the realtime step and heart-rate stream.
Pick the Badminton profile on SPORT READY (body mass and wrist side come from SETUP), then Start.
workout_tick samples HR, steps and motion at 1 Hz, also screen off; checkpoint request every 30 s and on lap or state change.
board-sense feeds about 150 Hz IMU; the detector finds wrist-movement bursts and returns valid_ms, movement_ms and burst counts.
HR lease renewed each second. Only produces bpm if the unverified MAX30102 strap is fitted.
Writes the 4304 B bank to /sdcard/watch/workouts/workouts.0|1.bin with fsync and readback; a RUNNING session restores as PAUSED.
SP_IMU, SP_HEART and SP_ACTIVITY records are queued to sports_sd and written to .spt journals.
FINISH SESSION saves history; SESSION DETAILS shows duration, steps, bursts and energy_kcal_est = MET x 3.5 x kg / 200 x minutes.
Jobs shows the sports session row with elapsed, steps and energy_kcal_est.
MISSING LINK: workout energy_kcal_est is never merged into the daily kcal (steps x 0.04).
MISSING: Energy BURN bins come from SP_ACTIVITY only, so workout calories never reach the Energy chart and there is no workout calorie graph.
Profile fields: sports_mass_kg (set in Sports) and the step goal. Mass is read only by the workout engine, not the daily total.
Only steps and walking reach the activity service; there is no resting or basal source.
MISSING LINK: daily kcal = steps x 0.04 with no BMR or basal term, so a still wrist burns zero.
SP_ACTIVITY every 60 s records cumulative steps-based kcal.
BURN bins are increments of that cumulative number, so idle hours are empty; food and water are shown beside them.
Today page shows the same steps-based kcal and the 24-column hourly chart.
Segment face kcal ring uses the same value.
MAX30102 strap (optional, unverified on B) produces red/IR FIFO data.
ext task wakes at most every 50 ms and runs hr_service.
With a lease, drains the FIFO every 120 ms and computes bpm, SpO2, quality and on-wrist; the lease expires 8 s after the last hal_hr_get.
Opening the app requests a stream lease, shows a 4 s PPG trace and a LOCKED BPM state.
Accepts the locked bpm/spo2 with its acquisition epoch and keeps day min, max and resting.
Background reads (first at +2 min, then every 10 min, up to 40 s) fill a 144-sample ring. Lost at reboot.
heart_tick every 60 s rebuilds the 24 h bins.
Home heart widget and the Split face show bpm_last.
The act stream sends hrm = bpm_last with no age check.
GPIO4 rail through a divider of 3; there is no charge-status pin.
Once per second triggers the sampler, with the screen on or off.
8 reads, median, EMA 1/5, bat_cal offset, percent model; valid after 10 stable seconds on battery; USB inferred from voltage.
sys_tick at 1 Hz mirrors percent and charging to screens and sends status to the phone every 10 min or on a 5 percent or charger change.
Low-battery latch: enter at 15 percent or below, leave at 20 percent or above. Idle target comes from prefs (default sensor_idle=1, so SENSOR).
After sleep_s (default 15 s) with no input, keep-awake screen or finger, the UI loop moves to SENSOR (default), AOD or OFF.
Brightness drops to the AOD level, or DISPOFF/SLPIN for OFF.
SENSOR and OFF cap the CPU at 80 MHz; services keep ticking once a second.
SP_BATTERY every 60 s and SP_RAIL every 1 s are journaled.
Battery history charts the 24 bins read back from the journal.

flows.title: Wake (raise / knock / button / touch) -> display on

steps.action: IMU samples are filtered and fanned to the wake service and knock detector (screen off included).
Raise-to-wake runs each loop pass (about 50 Hz) when the display is not ON; needs raise_wake, not locked, not low battery.
A double knock wakes the display (or toggles the lock) when knock_lock is set and the battery is not low.
BOOT press edge through the ISR with 25 ms debounce.
Touch still polled at 25 Hz when off; a finger-down also blocks the screen timeout.
Decides whether a wake request is allowed (low-battery latch).
The UI loop sees any wake source and goes to ON: brightness restored, frames resume, DFS raises to 240 MHz.
SLPOUT/DISPON and brightness are sent.
Home draws the face with the wake-from-AOD morph.

flows.title: Phone notification -> banner -> notifications app -> dismiss sync

steps.action: Sends a GB notify line over Nordic UART.
Assembles the line (up to 2048 B) and writes it to the 8 KB PSRAM ring.
phone_tick drains up to 8 lines per tick; once a second when the screen is off.
Parses notify, notify~ (update) or notify- (remove).
Adds to the 20-entry RAM store, bumps unread and raises the banner.
Banner overlay with app, title, icon and a tap callback.
Pull up from the face: cards newest first; tap for detail with OPEN and DISMISS; swipe or CLEAR ALL.
Dismiss removes the entry; nothing is persisted.
Sends {t:notify, id, n:DISMISS|OPEN} back to the phone.
A row edit writes the nos_prefs field directly and calls prefs_save().
Marks dirty. prefs_tick flushes 2 s after the last edit, 10 s at most, retry 5 s, and only when the persistence window is open.
Meanwhile the main loop applies the new value live: brightness, sleep timeout, fps cap, radios, timezone.
save_checked('nosprefs') routes to the SD banks first.
Writes the alternating 276 B checksummed bank with fsync and readback under the mount lease and SD lock.
settings.0.bin / settings.1.bin on SD are authoritative on B and loaded into RAM at boot.
NVS nosprefs is the mirror and card-absent fallback. A failed SD save stays dirty and retries.
Restart and power off flush prefs before parking.
Phone path: pushes a weather JSON (Kelvin temp, code, forecast) over GB.
Hands the weather line to the weather service.
Wi-Fi path: 1 s poll; fetches every 1800 s (60 s after failure) when Wi-Fi is up, a location exists and the clock is valid.
BROKEN PREREQUISITE: weather_loc must already be in NVS; nothing in the built NOS writes it (hal_weather_set_location has no caller).
Requests Open-Meteo for the stored lat/lon and parses the forecast.
wx_tick every 10 s prefers phone data under 3 h old, else the Wi-Fi snapshot. RAM only.
Weather app, Home widget and the Split face TMP row display the result.

flows.title: Alarm / timer firing while the app is closed

steps.action: The alarm was set earlier; svc_alarm_save wrote nosalarm to NVS.
With the screen off the loop runs at 50 Hz and calls nos_bg_tick(1.0) once a second.
svc_tick runs alarm_tick (local hour:minute and weekday) and the timer end check.
Matching alarm fires (timer uses a monotonic end time and fires the same way via svc-timer).
Arbiter find > call > alarm > timer: pushes the ring screen and repeats haptic and sound every 2 s.
The ring screen carries SCR_KEEPAWAKE, which forces the display ON.
Slide to stop or snooze 9 minutes; the timer's TIME'S UP offers STOP and +1 MIN; ring times out after 60 s.
app_main starts: pacing timer, flush/touch/cmd tasks, hardware init.
Initialises I2C devices, touch, IMU and the SD mount, and creates board-sense and board-fs.
board_restore_clock trusts the PCF85063 (OS and 12-hour bits rejected) and sets the system clock.
Loads nosprefs from the SD banks, falling back to NVS (via hal_store); legacy cfg is loaded too.
Prebakes dot masks and the orrery shade table on core 1.
svc_init clears the notification store, restores nosact, nosalarm, the pedometer and workout banks, and starts the weather task.
nos_apps_boot pushes the boot screen.
43 frames (about 1.1 s at 40 Hz): 49 dots form NOS; touch or button skips.
Hands over to Home with the face build-in; the face page is the root.

flows.title: Frame: input -> screen tick -> render -> blur -> flush -> panel

steps.action: Touch polled every 10 ms when ON; native coordinates map to the rotated UI as (465-y, x).
Polls FT3168 and pushes points into a ring; the UI loop drains it.
touch_drain empties the 16-entry ring and picks up button flags.
Recognises taps, drags, back-swipes and button click, double or long press.
frame_run: nos_bg_tick(dt) for services, then transitions and the tick of the top screen (dt bounded to 100 ms).
Screens draw into the command record; hashes are diffed so only damaged 16-row stripes are rasterised into DRAM.
A valid retained layer is blitted instead of redrawn.
Live blur is gated off on device (NOS_RENDER_SHARP=1); only the kblur card cache still bakes.
Stripe job and JOB_FENCE are queued to the flush task (depth 3).
Rotates the stripe CCW into the DMA buffers and draws it over QSPI at 80 MHz.
DMA-done credit returns. There is no TE wait on B, so tearing is possible.
Waits on the pace timer: 60 Hz present cap with a 40 Hz authored clock.

flows.title: Time source, RTC trust and midnight rollover

steps.action: At boot the chip supplies UTC as BCD; the OS and 12-hour bits are rejected.
board_restore_clock sets the system clock.
SNTP corrects the clock about hourly while Wi-Fi is connected.
Phone setTime and E.setTimeZone overwrite the clock and tz_min.
SET TIME and the timezone picker also change the clock.
Any change raises board_clock_changed.
rtc_maintain writes the new time back to the chip; forced at shutdown.
Local date from time() + tz; a timezone change closes the gate until the new day is settled.
act_rollover at local midnight archives the day and saves nosact immediately.

flows.title: USB host command and SD transfer

steps.action: flash_watch, sdsync or an export script sends a framed text command.
LF framing (191 B cap, NUL+LF resync) and the req <id> envelope.
Every 50 ms: SDXFER verbs are answered inline; other lines are queued.
The UI loop executes about 130 verbs: prefs, gb injection, ext debug, batcal, diag, open screen.
List/get/put SD files under the mount lease; mutation blocked during OTA.
A prefs flush checkpoint runs before flashing so settings are preserved.
